fixes_by_client_owner: Main view transfers session listeners and invalidates current actions using session identity, employee identity and epoch; lifecycle changes and privilege/generation changes close tracked private routes and discard stale success/error responses.
Nested descendants are closed before the owning private route is removed; Navigator mutations triggered during widget update run safely after the frame.
Main disposal dismisses tracked private routes, including nested child editors, while pending callbacks are already invalidated.

limits: This is targeted native Source4 lifecycle evidence, not a complete product/privacy/legal approval.
